    "dist",
    ".eggs",
    "docs/conf.py",
]

[tool.black]
line-length = 88

profile = "black"
line_length = 88
multi_line_output = 3
include_trailing_comma = true
force_grid_wrap = 0
use_parentheses = true
ensure_newline_before_comments = true
